decisions.reason: The cutting and creasing finisher is close to the core Multigraf line, has its own product page and costs little to keep as a distributor offering, so there is no strong reason to drop it.

The firm staged a public German premiere for the UV spot varnisher and presents it as a flagship of its embellishment direction, so visible commitment and strategic centrality favor persisting and attributing any slow uptake to market ramp-up.
The B2 multifinisher is a home-page flagship tightly tied to the core Duplo partnership and the firm's automation direction, so withdrawal is very unlikely.
The hybrid saddle stitcher sits in the booklet-making core, but the firm already pruned similar near-core products such as C and F, so the risk is moderate yet not enough to drop it.
